description: Saves, unsaves or lists the signed-in account's favorite AnimatedWebs templates, UI components and cinematic backgrounds. Use it when the user wants to keep an item for later or see what they kept; use get_account with include_items for the full picture (saved plus unlocked and generated items). action save adds the item (saving twice is a no-op), unsave removes only the bookmark (removing an unsaved item is a no-op, and it can be saved again), list returns saved items newest first, optionally only one type. Saved templates are the same list as the Save heart on animatedwebs.com and the dashboard. The id must exist in the catalog. Examples: {"action":"save","type":"template","id":"aurora-site"}, {"action":"list","type":"component"}.

action.description: save: add a favorite. unsave: remove it. list: show saved items.

id.description: Required for save and unsave: template slug, component id or background slug exactly as returned by search_catalog, e.g. 'aurora-site'.

limit.description: For list: how many items, 1 to 50 (default 20).

type.description: template (default for save and unsave), component or background. For list, filters to one type; omit to list all.

name: save_item

id.description: Template slug, component id or background slug

title.description: null when the item left the catalog

saved.description: For save and unsave: whether the item is saved after the call

title: Save an AnimatedWebs item
